caption: This romantic Bollywood track features a smooth, expressive male lead vocal singing heartfelt lyrics in Hindi. The arrangement is built around rhythmic acoustic guitar strums, atmospheric synth pads, and a polished mid-tempo electronic beat driven by crisp percussion and subtle bass. The overall production is clean and modern, creating a warm, sweet, and affectionate mood.
lyrics: तेरा ही उंटिजार है तू भन जा भन जा तु मेरी इश्के थी चाशने औ मिठ्षी विट्षी चाशने ना उमाँ गा दूप दिनी दिनी मैं ना मांगु चांगनी मेरे जीने मैं तुज़ से हो इशके दी चाशनी
